utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep everyone posted that the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — Sunday at the community center is much easier to plan around. Please let me know if the timing or transport shifts again.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll keep both steady and give you a heads-up if anything changes. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: You’re welcome — Sunday at the community center by the blue mailbox is right. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, I’ve got it now — Sunday at the community center by the blue mailbox.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I’ll bring the hammer, screwdriver set, spare screws, and maybe a utility knife if I can find one.

utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Bo — that should set us up nicely for the repair drive. Thanks for rounding all that up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Glad to help — I’ll bring what I can and keep an eye out for extra tape or zip ties too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll keep an eye out for the updated list and be ready to help on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate it, and I’ll get that updated list over to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You bet, Tess — I’ll be ready to help as soon as the list comes through.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the church hall at 10 a.m. first for the repair drive. Thanks, Ira.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that’s the right place and time. Let me know if you need anything else while you’re there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do, thanks, Ira.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — I’m still expecting their confirmation today, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still scheduled for Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, that’s still the plan for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll update you as soon as they confirm.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing—nothing big yet, just a lot of steady support. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate the update. I’ll keep an ear out and check back if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Dane — I’ll keep the spot open for you and have everything ready when you get here.

utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll see you tomorrow at 3:30, and we’ll start with the donations and parts list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye. I’ll be there early and we can work through the donations first, then the parts list.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Hana — see you there!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday. I’ll be at the donations table — see you there, Noah.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Sunday at the community center — thanks for catching that. I’ll come by the donations table and look for you there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep, Sunday at the community center — I’ll be at the donations table. See you then, Noah.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m pulling the list together now. What should go first on your end?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Let’s start with the loose porch rail and the leaky kitchen faucet on my end. I can also help check in on the volunteer list if you need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — I’ll put the porch rail and kitchen faucet at the top, and I’d appreciate your help checking the volunteer list too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — it’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. Can you still make it?

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — I’m still waiting on the pickup time and driver details so I can line up the Sunday timing at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — I’ll confirm the pickup time and who’s driving, then I’ll send you the Sunday schedule for the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — once I have the pickup time and driver, I can sort the timing for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.text: Jules: Great — thanks, Ira. If you can, swing by the church hall at 10 a.m. first; that’s where the repair drive is starting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — I’ll see you after drop-off at 3:30, and we can start wherever needed first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yep, that works for me — I’ll see you there after 3.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ve got you on the list for Sunday at the community center after 3. Looking forward to seeing you there!
